description: In Potter, Tioga and Bradford counties, life revolves around our love for our beautiful land. You see it in the dairy farms outside Coudersport, the quiet streets of Wellsboro, the Pine Creek Gorge and the rolling hills around Towanda. You feel it standing knee-deep in Pine Creek, casting for trout, or walking a ridge at first light during hunting season.Out here, clean water and open land are not luxuries.
